name: Vremya peremen
source:
Semyon's life is falling apart: his parents are getting a divorce, he failed an important exam, and he's been transferred to the problematic 10 "V" class. Can he survive the bullying, find new friends, and make the right choice between three very different girls? Balance between studies, ambitions, and relationships in this atmospheric coming-of-age visual novel.

[From [url=https://vkplay.ru/play/game/time-for-changes-47334]VK Play[/url]]
